title: Consistent characters
summary: Keep a person, mascot or product looking the same across shots: build a character from reference images and written rules, add it to a project and attach it to Canvas drafts.

inputs.label: Who or what must stay the same
inputs.description: A person, mascot or product, with what must never change about it.

inputs.label: Reference images
inputs.description: Project images or absolute local image paths; one clear front view becomes the main image.

stages.title: Define the character
stages.description: Find an existing character or create one from images, a description and keep/never rules the user agreed to.

stages.title: Use it in a project
stages.description: Copy the references into the project and attach the main image and brief to the Canvas draft.

stages.title: Revise
stages.description: Change rules or images against the current version without overwriting someone else's change.
